parameters.query:
WITH chosen AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.profile_id
  FROM profile_ai_sessions s
  JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
  WHERE s.user_id = $1::uuid
    AND lower(u.role) = 'woman'
    AND s.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT id::text AS session_id, user_id::text, profile_id::text
FROM chosen;

INSERT INTO profile_photos (profile_id, telegram_file_id, position)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2::text, COALESCE(MAX(position), -1) + 1
FROM profile_photos
WHERE profile_id = $1::uuid
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::uuid profile_id, $2::uuid session_id, $3::jsonb payload),
updated_profile AS (
 UPDATE profiles p SET
  name=COALESCE(input.payload->'fields'->>'name',p.name),
  age=COALESCE((input.payload->'fields'->>'age')::int,p.age),
  city=COALESCE(input.payload->'fields'->>'city',p.city),
  city_normalized=COALESCE(normalize_city_name(input.payload->'fields'->>'city'),p.city_normalized),
  district=COALESCE(input.payload->'fields'->>'district',p.district),
  height_cm=COALESCE((input.payload->'fields'->>'height_cm')::smallint,p.height_cm),
  weight_kg=COALESCE((input.payload->'fields'->>'weight_kg')::numeric,p.weight_kg),
  breast_size=COALESCE((input.payload->'fields'->>'breast_size')::numeric,p.breast_size),
  description=COALESCE(input.payload->'fields'->>'description',p.description), updated_at=now()
 FROM input WHERE p.id=input.profile_id RETURNING p.id
),
price_rows AS (
 INSERT INTO profile_prices(profile_id,service_name,amount,currency,duration_minutes,description,position)
 SELECT input.profile_id,x.service_name,x.amount,COALESCE(x.currency,'RUB'),x.duration_minutes,x.description,x.ord-1
 FROM input CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(COALESCE(input.payload->'prices','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(service_name text,amount numeric,currency char(3),duration_minutes int,description text,ord bigint)
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(x.service_name),'') IS NOT NULL AND x.amount>=0
 ON CONFLICT(profile_id,position) DO UPDATE SET service_name=EXCLUDED.service_name,amount=EXCLUDED.amount,currency=EXCLUDED.currency,duration_minutes=EXCLUDED.duration_minutes,description=EXCLUDED.description,updated_at=now() RETURNING id
),
place_rows AS (
 INSERT INTO profile_meeting_places(profile_id,place_type,label,district,description,position)
 SELECT input.profile_id,x.place_type,x.label,x.district,x.description,x.ord-1
 FROM input CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(COALESCE(input.payload->'meeting_places','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(place_type text,label text,district text,description text,ord bigint)
 WHERE x.place_type IN ('HER_PLACE','HIS_PLACE','HOTEL','PUBLIC_PLACE','OTHER') AND NULLIF(btrim(x.label),'') IS NOT NULL
 ON CONFLICT(profile_id,position) DO UPDATE SET place_type=EXCLUDED.place_type,label=EXCLUDED.label,district=EXCLUDED.district,description=EXCLUDED.description,updated_at=now() RETURNING id
),
context AS (
 UPDATE profile_ai_sessions s SET ai_context=COALESCE(s.ai_context,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object('last_extraction',(SELECT payload FROM input)),updated_at=now()
 FROM input WHERE s.id=input.session_id RETURNING s.id
)
SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM updated_profile) profile_id,(SELECT id::text FROM context) session_id,(SELECT count(*) FROM price_rows) prices_saved,(SELECT count(*) FROM place_rows) places_saved;

SELECT p.id::text profile_id,s.id::text session_id,p.name,p.age,p.city,p.city_normalized,p.district,p.height_cm,p.weight_kg,p.breast_size,p.description,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM profile_photos x WHERE x.profile_id=p.id) photo_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM profile_prices x WHERE x.profile_id=p.id AND x.is_active) price_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM profile_meeting_places x WHERE x.profile_id=p.id AND x.is_active) meeting_place_count
FROM profile_ai_sessions s JOIN profiles p ON p.id=s.profile_id
WHERE s.id=$1::uuid AND s.status='IN_PROGRESS';

parameters.jsCode: const x=$json; const checks=[['name',x.name],['age',x.age],['city',x.city_normalized],['district',x.district],['height',x.height_cm],['weight',x.weight_kg],['breast_size',x.breast_size],['description',x.description],['photos',Number(x.photo_count)>0],['prices',Number(x.price_count)>0],['meeting_places',Number(x.meeting_place_count)>0]]; const i=checks.findIndex(([,v])=>v===null||v===undefined||v===''||v===false); const questions={name:'Как тебя зовут?',age:'Сколько тебе лет?',city:'В каком городе ты живёшь?',district:'Какой район?',height:'Какой у тебя рост в сантиметрах?',weight:'Какой вес в килограммах?',breast_size:'Укажи числовой размер груди.',description:'Расскажи о себе.',photos:'Добавь хотя бы одно фото.',prices:'Укажи цены.',meeting_places:'Укажи места встречи.'}; return [{json:{...x,complete:i<0,current_step:i<0?checks.length:i,next_block:i<0?null:checks[i][0],question:i<0?null:questions[checks[i][0]]}}];

parameters.query: UPDATE profile_ai_sessions SET current_step=$2::int,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='IN_PROGRESS' RETURNING id::text, $3::boolean AS complete;

WITH completed AS (UPDATE profile_ai_sessions SET status='COMPLETED',updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='IN_PROGRESS' RETURNING user_id,profile_id),
profile AS (UPDATE profiles p SET status='PENDING_MODERATION',updated_at=now() FROM completed c WHERE p.id=c.profile_id RETURNING p.id),
moderation AS (INSERT INTO profile_moderation(profile_id,moderator_type,status) SELECT id,'AI','PENDING' FROM profile WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profile_moderation m WHERE m.profile_id=profile.id AND m.status='PENDING') RETURNING id),
audit AS (INSERT INTO audit_events(user_id,event_type,event_data) SELECT c.user_id,'profile_created',jsonb_build_object('profile_id',c.profile_id) FROM completed c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audit_events a WHERE a.event_type='profile_created' AND a.event_data->>'profile_id'=c.profile_id::text) RETURNING id)
